query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `emotionalUnderstandings` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `userExpressionId` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `understanding` text NOT NULL,
  `confidence` decimal(3,2),
  `reasoning` text,
  `emotionalState` json,
  `behavioralSignals` json,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (`userExpressionId`) REFERENCES `emotionalExpressions`(`id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`)
);
